segments.section: When having noodle dishes — eating out choices
segments.text:
When having noodle dishes, choose:
Clear soup (e.g. yong tau foo, fish soup) instead of thickened soup, coconut based, oily soup (e.g. curry laksa, lor mee).
Ask for less noodles and more vegetables.
